opposite.label: Identify the opposite face
opposite.observed: Face normals reached by folding the net distinguish opposite and adjacent colors.
opposite.construct: Put a visually nearby color on an adjacent face and the true opposite farther along the fold path. Vary the layout and assignment; compare the two normals.

color-view.label: Choose a colored corner view
color-view.observed: Three faces meeting at a corner retain cyclic order after a proper rotation.
color-view.construct: Use six different colors and a mirrored corner order as a plausible alternative. Vary the net and the target corner; evaluate the ordered triad.

pips.label: Choose a pips corner view
pips.observed: Printed face orientation travels with the fold.
pips.construct: Use a directional pip pair on a visible face. Keep its identity and adjacent faces fixed while varying the mark direction in a foil. Check both ordered corner and orientation after folding.
